attachments_payment_ck.name: attachments_payment_ck
attachments_payment_ck.value: "attachments"."payment_id" is null or "attachments"."expense_id" is not null

attachments_size_ck.name: attachments_size_ck
attachments_size_ck.value:
("attachments"."size_bytes" is null or "attachments"."size_bytes" >= 0)
			and ("attachments"."width" is null or "attachments"."width" > 0)
			and ("attachments"."height" is null or "attachments"."height" > 0)
			and ("attachments"."duration_sec" is null or "attachments"."duration_sec" >= 0)

list_items_due_tz_ck.name: list_items_due_tz_ck
list_items_due_tz_ck.value: ("list_items"."due_time" is null) or ("list_items"."due_tz" is not null)

yjs_documents_name_ck.name: yjs_documents_name_ck
yjs_documents_name_ck.value:
"yjs_documents"."name" = 'trip/' || "yjs_documents"."trip_id"::text || case
				when "yjs_documents"."node_id" is not null then '/node/' || "yjs_documents"."node_id"::text
				when "yjs_documents"."leg_id" is not null then '/leg/' || "yjs_documents"."leg_id"::text
				when "yjs_documents"."item_id" is not null then '/item/' || "yjs_documents"."item_id"::text
				when "yjs_documents"."day_id" is not null then '/day/' || "yjs_documents"."day_id"::text
				else '/root' end || case
				when "yjs_documents"."owner_user_id" is not null then '/u/' || "yjs_documents"."owner_user_id"
				else '' end

budget_lines_default_seen_ck.name: budget_lines_default_seen_ck
budget_lines_default_seen_ck.value: "budget_lines"."default_seen_minor" is null or "budget_lines"."member_id" is not null

expense_fees_value_ck.name: expense_fees_value_ck
expense_fees_value_ck.value:
("expense_fees"."kind" = 'percent' and "expense_fees"."percent" is not null and "expense_fees"."percent" between 0 and 100)
			or ("expense_fees"."kind" = 'fixed' and "expense_fees"."amount_minor" is not null)

expenses_sign_ck.name: expenses_sign_ck
expenses_sign_ck.value: "expenses"."amount_minor" is null or "expenses"."amount_minor" >= 0 or "expenses"."refund_of_id" is not null

expenses_some_cost_ck.name: expenses_some_cost_ck
expenses_some_cost_ck.value: "expenses"."amount_minor" is not null or "expenses"."points" is not null

expenses_points_ck.name: expenses_points_ck
expenses_points_ck.value: ("expenses"."points" is null) = ("expenses"."points_program" is null) and ("expenses"."points" is null or "expenses"."points" > 0)

expenses_source_points_ck.name: expenses_source_points_ck
expenses_source_points_ck.value: ("expenses"."source_points" is null) = ("expenses"."source_program" is null) and ("expenses"."source_points" is null or "expenses"."source_points" > 0)

expenses_currency_ck.name: expenses_currency_ck
expenses_currency_ck.value:
("expenses"."currency" is null or "expenses"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')
			and ("expenses"."home_currency" is null or "expenses"."home_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')
			and ("expenses"."cash_value_currency" is null or "expenses"."cash_value_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

expenses_text_ck.name: expenses_text_ck
expenses_text_ck.value: char_length("expenses"."title") between 1 and 120 and ("expenses"."note" is null or char_length("expenses"."note") <= 2000)

nodes_latlng_range_ck.name: nodes_latlng_range_ck
nodes_latlng_range_ck.value: "nodes"."lat" is null or ("nodes"."lat" between -90 and 90 and "nodes"."lng" between -180 and 180)

items_located_or_titled_ck.name: items_located_or_titled_ck
items_located_or_titled_ck.value: "items"."node_id" is not null or "items"."title" is not null

legs_shape_ck.name: legs_shape_ck
legs_shape_ck.value:
("legs"."kind" = 'pair' and "legs"."from_item_id" is not null and "legs"."to_item_id" is not null
				and "legs"."stay_day_id" is null and "legs"."from_item_id" <> "legs"."to_item_id")
			or ("legs"."kind" <> 'pair' and "legs"."from_item_id" is null and "legs"."to_item_id" is null and "legs"."stay_day_id" is not null)

legs_flight_ck.name: legs_flight_ck
legs_flight_ck.value: "legs"."mode" is distinct from 'flight' or ("legs"."kind" = 'pair' and "legs"."dep_at" is not null and "legs"."arr_at" is not null)

legs_timed_order_ck.name: legs_timed_order_ck
legs_timed_order_ck.value: "legs"."dep_at" is null or "legs"."arr_at" is null or "legs"."arr_at" > "legs"."dep_at"

legs_minutes_ck.name: legs_minutes_ck
legs_minutes_ck.value:
("legs"."duration_min" is null or "legs"."duration_min" >= 0)
			and ("legs"."estimate_min" is null or "legs"."estimate_min" >= 0)
			and ("legs"."distance_m" is null or "legs"."distance_m" >= 0)

trip_members_status_ck.name: trip_members_status_ck
trip_members_status_ck.value:
("trip_members"."status" = 'active' and "trip_members"."user_id" is not null)
			or ("trip_members"."status" = 'invited' and "trip_members"."user_id" is null and "trip_members"."email" is not null)
			or ("trip_members"."status" = 'placeholder' and "trip_members"."user_id" is null)
			or ("trip_members"."status"::text = 'removed' and "trip_members"."user_id" is null and "trip_members"."display_name" is not null)

trips_dates_ck.name: trips_dates_ck
trips_dates_ck.value: "trips"."start_date" is null or "trips"."end_date" is null or "trips"."start_date" <= "trips"."end_date"
